topic: Concurrency and Sync Primitives for Performance Gains
explanation: Concurrency allows multiple tasks to make progress simultaneously, improving performance in systems with multiple processing cores or I/O operations. Synchronization primitives are mechanisms that ensure concurrent tasks access shared resources in a controlled manner, preventing race conditions and data corruption.  This is crucial in operating systems and high-performance computing where multiple threads or processes interact.
